desc: RAND's headquarters and the registered location of three of its four FFRDCs - Project AIR FORCE, the Arroyo Center and the National Defense Research Institute. It is where the contractor-operated analytical institution was invented in 1948, where George Kocher wrote 'UFOs: What To Do?' in 1968, and where RAND's 2023 UAP mapping study was produced. The fourth RAND FFRDC, the Homeland Security Operational Analysis Center, is in Arlington, Virginia.
